run.title: Ember Rite · District production
run.summary: Explore the surveyed Monsoon Exchange district from the map, the Blender model or four eye-height routes. The Dust source inventory explains what carries into the design. The four existing solo districts, listening drill and Mandala retake roadmap remain available.

jobs.title: Read the architectural and literary sources
jobs.summary: The panel linked the four fictional districts to archaeological observations, specific epic passages and historical map conventions. Each source note identifies which features it informed.
jobs.next_step: Ask players to name the landmark and their destination from each approach.

jobs.title: Measure the openings and retakes
jobs.summary: The authored graph compares site entry leads, independent door pairs and the time available after a dry rotation. Closing a central room or interrupting a nearly complete quench changes that margin.
jobs.next_step: Compare modeled arrivals with both teams in the first human playtest.

jobs.title: Draw the architecture and check the spaces
jobs.summary: Each district pairs a circulation plan and encounter sheet with an architectural drawing. The massing overview and sightline probes provide a second way to inspect the corridors and covers.
jobs.next_step: Walk both hero capsules and their cameras through the first networked district.

jobs.title: Walk and quench in the four districts
jobs.summary: The same portable exercise opens from the public snapshot or local dashboard. Explore a district, carry the vessel to a site or time a quench after crossing from the other site.
jobs.next_step: Collect observed paths and first-time wayfinding errors for each entrance.

jobs.title: Broaden Hanuman’s escort and Rama’s rotation
jobs.summary: A wounded teammate can receive a single aid pulse on Sena’s arrival. Measured Step can return a spent arrow after Rama travels the required distance. Both additions run in the skirmish and private rooms.
jobs.next_step: Log eligible allies, beneficial impacts and earned arrows during side-swapped matches.

outputs.label: Game and room host on GitHub

jobs.title: Bring the vessel into one authoritative district
jobs.summary: Carry, kindle and quench run in the solo rehearsal. The next network build must synchronize possession, collision, interruption and side swaps in one district.
jobs.next_step: Clear the room-host and two-rendered-client acceptance scenarios.

jobs.title: Run side-swapped human matches
jobs.summary: The floors, drawings and rehearsed timings establish where to test. Pick preferences, counterplay outcomes and match win rates need player observations.
jobs.next_step: Record map, side, repeated teams and cast opportunities before comparing outcomes.

jobs.title: Show Sena’s landing to the remote player
jobs.summary: The defender received 25 active-field updates and lost 28 HP. All 40 sampled observations during the cast showed one rendered frame, so the player missed the five guardians. Three scratch render changes failed the two-window check.
jobs.next_step: Repeat the cast, escape and ordinary movement on two hardware-rendered clients. Record the first visible guardian and the last active field tick.

jobs.summary: 53 named places, routes and props each have a concept painting, an orthographic drawing, four Blender views, a camera study and an individual GLB. The district includes a tour, a Cycles lighting study and a 62-part pavilion assembly.
jobs.next_step: Use the standalone model origins to instance a first corridor in the authoritative district. Measure visibility, collision and the cost of the rendered scene on target hardware.

milestones.evidence: District JSON feeds the drawings, massing and solo drill. The two additive hero mechanics use the Rust game authority.

milestones.title: Recheck the route decisions and publish the handoff
milestones.evidence: The balance tables exercise an interrupted quench and a closed middle room. The blueprint, rehearsal, room-role checks and next production gates are linked in this checkpoint.

milestones.title: Measure site cover, climbs and aerial casts
milestones.evidence: A four-expert, three-round study measured 27 entrances, four lofts, 19 trajectories and 53 art subjects. Two window sizes exercised the complete ground and replay controls.

milestones.title: Bring Mandala Rift into the room host
milestones.evidence: Two rendered clients must agree on position, possession, interruption, the result and the next round after reconnect.

milestones.title: Test paired folds and camera clearance
milestones.evidence: On two hardware-rendered clients, verify the 4.23 m pavilion beam, fold returns and camera clearance at both corrected Bazaar double-file crossings.

milestones.title: Coordinate the team and review its decisions
milestones.evidence: Track possession and objective events once. Compare eligible healing and recovered arrows with actions the team actually used.

milestones.title: Rehearse, then play both sides with people
milestones.evidence: Run the ten-seat Ember script on both sides. Record loft choice, time to first contest, crouched vs standing shelters, audible cast recognition and A/B retake outcomes.

milestones.title: Deliver original sound in the four solo districts
milestones.evidence: Six musical parts and a full audition, four bilingual guide takes, a checked offline title and an independent 40-second Chromium burn.

milestones.title: Qualify competitive listening during a Mandala retake
milestones.evidence: Compare the actual event streams for ten seats, reconnect and spectators, then measure identification of cast, bearing and outcome on physical devices.

milestones.title: Build and verify the Monsoon Exchange district
milestones.evidence: Survey, Blender and GLB agree on legal routes and cover. Each entrance has two assigned standing shelters. The browser exposes four eye-height walks.

milestones.title: Commission Monsoon Exchange for a ten-seat retake
milestones.evidence: Apply server collision and test vessel actions, cross-site returns and side-swapped opening times on ten clients.
